description: This file defines the final class 'CallableArgumentsExtractor' within the Twig templating engine, responsible for extracting and validating function/method arguments in Twig templates, handling named, positional, variadic, and default arguments, and throwing syntax errors for invalid argument usage.

classes.name: CallableArgumentsExtractor
classes.description: A utility class for extracting and validating arguments for callables in Twig templates, supporting named, positional, variadic, and default arguments, with error handling for invalid argument configurations.

methods.name: extractArguments
methods.description: Extracts and validates arguments for a given Node, handling named, positional, variadic, and default arguments, and throws syntax errors for invalid usage.

methods.name: normalizeName
methods.description: Converts argument names to a normalized lowercase string without underscores.

methods.name: toSnakeCase
methods.description: Converts a string from CamelCase or other formats to snake_case.

methods.name: getCallableParameters
methods.description: Retrieves and processes the parameters of the callable, accounting for special Twig requirements and variadic parameters.
